mahoutsukai.book.alarm_boundary.desc: The Alarm Boundary is perhaps the most basic of boundary magic - it simply alerts you to mobs and players as they enter the range (%%val2) of the boundary. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster every %%val1 second(s). %%n%%nAlarm boundaries will also output a comparator value of 15 when it detects anything in the boundary.
mahoutsukai.book.alchemical_exchange.des: This circle will, once a day around the time of placement, convert blocks underneath it into random other blocks of the same class. For example, dirt may become sand, diamonds may become emeralds, etc. However, this only works on natural blocks, and will not work on things such as bricks or diamond blocks. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster per transformation.
mahoutsukai.book.ascension.desc: This spell, when used without a cloth, will teleport any thing (including items and mobs) on top of it to the highest solid Y value it can find. The scroll version of this spell will simply transport the caster. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster per teleport.
mahoutsukai.book.binding_eyes.desc: When used, eye contact between the caster and any mob or player binds that mob or player in place. Players, however, can escape this binding by simply breaking eye contact. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on use.
mahoutsukai.book.black_flame_eyes.desc: When used, black flames will sprout at the caster's viewing location for a short time. These flames spread somewhat quickly, but do not consume blocks and inflict wither damage to those who come in contact with them. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.borrowed_authority.desc: Borrow the authority of the gods with this scroll, which increases the caster's speed and power, to the extent that mobs hit while using it will break through walls. Hold the jump button to jump further and hold it while in the air to "stick" to the surface you land on. Hold left click while running/jumping to target any enemies you bump into. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.boundaries.desc: Boundaries are a category of AOE spells which operate in a radius around a placed circle, and drain mana on a fixed basis. You can turn them on and off by right clicking them. A redstone signal will also invert their on/off status. %%n%%nBoundaries give off comparator output - 0 when off, 1 when on. %%n%%nLastly, boundary scrolls can be used to quickly place boundaries in another location.
mahoutsukai.book.butterfly_effect.desc: When this scroll is used, the caster is granted Foresight for a short duration. During this time, breaking/placing a block, or swinging a weapon will be delayed for the future. A butterfly will mark the spot, and things colliding with this butterfly will trigger its effect.%%n%%nWARNING: DO NOT USE ON IMPORTANT BLOCKS.%%n%%nThis spell drains %%val0 mana from the caster upon use.
mahoutsukai.book.catalyst_exchange.desc: When placed on the floor, this circle will convert any powdered catalysts on top of it into a new random powdered catalyst. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster per transformation.
mahoutsukai.book.catalysts2.desc: The categories are: %%n%%nIron - Boundaries%%n%%nEnder Pearl - Displacement%%n%%nDiamond - Projection%%n%%nEmerald - Exchange%%n%%nGold - Mystic%%n%%nQuartz - Intelligence%%n%%nEnder Eye - Mystic Eyes
mahoutsukai.book.categories.desc: Boundaries deal with AOE effects centered on a magic circle.%%n%%nDisplacement spells deal with teleportation magic.%%n%%nProjection spells deal with weapons.%%n%%nExchange spells usually involve a trade of some sort, often to refund or generate mana.
mahoutsukai.book.categories2.desc: Mystic spells are unique, often offenseive spells, which provide miscellaneous effects.%%n%%nMystic Eyes spells deal with sight based effects.%%n%%nIntelligence spells deal with decision making, often focused around entities.%%n%%nThere are also some rumored secret spells..
mahoutsukai.book.chronal_exchange.desc: When placed on the floor, this circle will generate mana for 12 hours, centered on the time of placement. For the other 12 hours, it will drain mana from the caster, gems, or mana circuits. %%n %%nIt will drain or restore up to %%val0 mana every so often, depending on how far it is from its peak. Note that skipping time will only delay the cycle, instead of skipping it.
mahoutsukai.book.clairvoyance.desc: When used, the caster will be able to see the predicted path of certain mobs. Unfortunately, some mobs are an enigma and cannot be predicted accurately, such as skeletons. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on use.
mahoutsukai.book.clarent.desc: A strengthened sword forged in dragon's breath, Clarent has one purpose: to overthrow the king. %%n%%nRather than retaining a damage value, Clarent instead does the damage of its opponent's weapon.%%n%%nClarent's passive, Vengeance, allows it to block attacks. Clarent remembers these attacks, and in its next attack will release its pent up frustrations.
mahoutsukai.book.contract.desc: When two players create their own contract circles, and stand on them nearby, a contract will be formed between the players. Contracts allow players to bypass certain effects such as boundaries and some mystic eyes. To break a contract, one player need only damage the other. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from each player when a contract is formed.
mahoutsukai.book.cup_of_heaven3.desc: For a cup of heaven which grants poison 1 and wither 1, for example, you could simply create a 22-sided polygon and all mobs inside would be affected. %%n %%nMana cost varies depending on the effects and area covered.
mahoutsukai.book.damage_exchange.desc: When used, the player will convert damage taken into mana a set number of times (not time-based). %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on use.
mahoutsukai.book.damage_replication.desc: When used on another mob or player, this scroll will replicate damage and potions that affect the caster to the target. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on using the scroll.
mahoutsukai.book.death_collection_eyes.d: When used, the caster collects souls upon seeing death - this death can occur in any way, but the caster does have to be looking at it. If the caster has collected enough souls, their death will be prevented in exchange for souls, whether or not the eyes are active. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.displacement_boundary.d: The Displacement Boundary teleports entities that attempt to enter the range (%%val2) of the boundary to the other side of the boundary. In doing so, it will attempt to displace blocks that would suffocate said entity. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster every %%val1 second(s).
mahoutsukai.book.drain_life_boundary.des: The Boundary of Drain Life slowly drains health from nearby mobs in a range of %%val2. For every health drained, health, hunger, or mana is restored to the caster, in that order, according to the caster's needs. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster every %%val1 second(s).
mahoutsukai.book.durability_exchange.des: When placed on the floor, this circle will convert the durability of items on top of it into mana. Alternatively, it can do so from a chest underneath it as well. %%n %%nIt can restore a maximum of %%val0 mana per second. Note that higher durability items are consumed faster.
mahoutsukai.book.emrys.desc: A staff named after it's original owner, a backwards mage who couldn't decide which weapon was his favorite, Emrys is intended to be used in the off-hand. It provides strength in the form of lightning to an empty right hand, melee weapons, and some projectile weapons.%%n%%nThe mage who created the staff luckily documented his struggles - simply get struck by lightning while holding a strengthened stick.
mahoutsukai.book.enclosure_boundary.desc: The Enclosure Boundary raises the floor around you to create a makeshift set of walls with radius %%val1. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster for every layer of blocks that it raises.
mahoutsukai.book.equivalent_displacement: An Equivalent Displacement circle on the ground can be linked (by shift-right-clicking) to another equivalent displacement circle anywhere in the world or across dimensions. However, a teleport between the two can only happen if there is something on BOTH circles. That something can be an item or mob. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster per teleport.
mahoutsukai.book.explosion_staff.desc: This scroll summons a staff with explosive power. The staff has a long charge up time (the beam in the middle indicates readiness), and creates a large explosion. Shift right clicking with the staff will change it to fire multiple, smaller, explosions, and shift right clicking again will enable a beam mode.
mahoutsukai.book.explosion_staff2.desc: When in beam mode the staff's damage accelerates the longer the beam is held. Also, the beam will destroy blocks it comes in contact with. %%n %%nThe scroll drains %%val0 mana from the caster, %%val1 mana when using the large explosion mode, %%val2 mana when using the AOE explosion mode, and %%val3 mana per tick when using the beam mode.
mahoutsukai.book.fae.desc: The Fae are spiritlike creatures that occasionally roam the earth. Like leylines, they can also only be seen with Mystic Eyes of Fay Sight. Their laughter sounds like bells, and they drop Fae Essence upon death.%%n%%nThe Fae are particularly attracted to magic being performed on leypoints. %%n%%nThey are breedable through the use of any Powdered Catalyst.
mahoutsukai.book.fallen_down.desc: Give your friends, enemies and acquaintances the burial they deserve! It may be best not to do this near things you care about, though.%%n%%nThis spell costs %%val0 mana every fifth of a second. Naturally, the longer you channel it, the deeper the grave. Your friends should thank you, really. Note: Flight is a natural counter to this spell.
mahoutsukai.book.familiar_exchange.desc: When used, the caster will switch places with the familiar if it exists. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.familiars_garden.desc: When used while a familiar is active, the familiar will activate its garden. Mobs and players in the garden will not be able to harm each other. The affected area moves with the familiar, and particles are produced to show the area. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.fay_sight_eyes.desc: Very simply, this spell allows the player to see Leylines and the Fae. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.fun1.desc: You have been identified as displaying symptoms of an unfortunate syndrome in which you attempt to acquire as much damage as possible without having fun. %%nAs a result, you have been prescribed a strict regiment of fun activities, after the completion of which you will be allowed to proceed with the ritual you were attempting, should you still desire to.
mahoutsukai.book.gandr.desc: A primeval curse which gains power based on the user's magical capability. Requiring a percentage of the user's mana capacity, when fired, this curse scales damage depending on the amount of mana spent to fire it.%%n%%nFurthermore, this curse will absorb and cleanse any negative effects the user may be experiencing, and spread them around its point of impact.
mahoutsukai.book.geas.desc: Geasa are self-imposed taboos. By placing a geas on oneself, you can prevent yourself from doing some undesirable things.%%n%%nFor example, using it on a player will prevent you from harming that player. Using it on a sheep will prevent you from harming any sheep.%%n%%nBurning a geas scroll will remove all geasa.
mahoutsukai.book.geas2.desc: Using it on a named sheep will prevent you from harming that specific sheep. Lastly, using it on a dropped item, will prevent you from picking up that item. Use it without a target to see your current geasa. Creating and removing geasa costs %%val0 mana each, and having many geasa targeting unnamed mobs will regenerate mana.
mahoutsukai.book.gravity_boundary.desc: The Gravity Boundary increases the gravity for mobs other than the caster in an area of range %%val2. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster every %%val1 second(s).
mahoutsukai.book.immunity_exchange.desc: This scroll can be used on either the player or something the player is looking at. The target of the scroll will take no damage from repeated damage sources, but will take double damage from a damage source that was different from the last one. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.insight.desc: The Mystic Eyes of Insight allow the user to see more information about a target, such as its inventory, and, in the case of living creatures, their buffs, debuffs, etc. The mana cost is %%val0 per scroll.
mahoutsukai.book.intro.desc: A mahoutsukai, simply, is a magic user. And congrats! You are one such magic user. %%n%%nLet's first see how to draw a circle in blood. It's easy - just take damage, and quickly use the keybind %%k to draw a circle in blood on the floor. If successful, you'll see a blood circle on the ground, and a mana bar (Mahou X/Y) somewhere on your screen. Note: there is a dagger to damage yourself, if you prefer.
mahoutsukai.book.kodoku.desc: Kodoku refers to the practice of encouraging conflict between a number living things, and then harnessing the strongest surviving thing's essence for power using special Kodoku worms. %%n %%nEvery time a monster kills something, their kodoku value goes up by 1, plus the kodoku value of the monster it killed. When you have a specimen with a high kodoku value, simply place a hungry kodoku worm on it (right-click) and kill the specimen.
mahoutsukai.book.kodoku2.desc: When a worm consumes the essence of a mob with a high kodoku value, you can simply right-click to pick it up. Worms with high kodoku values have a number of uses. %%n %%nWhen burned, these worms will generate mana for any nearby mana circuits. The amount of mana depends on how close to a leyline the burning occurred. %%n%%nThese worms can also be used for sympathetic magic.
mahoutsukai.book.kodoku3.desc: Sympathetic Magic refers to a symbolic magic, in which a target can be affected remotely through the use of a symbol. %%n%%nTo use a scrying circle for sympathetic magic, it must be actively scrying something. Also, an inventory under the scrying circle must contain Kodoku worms to act as fuel. Worms with higher kodoku values will increase the chance of successful sympathetic magic.
mahoutsukai.book.kodoku4.desc: When an active scrying circle with Kodoku worms underneath is set up, simply throw items for various effects on top of the circle. %%n%%nBlaze Powder - Fire%%n%%nRabbit Foot - Hop%%n%%nSplash Potions - Effects%%n%%nGlowstone Dust - Glowing%%n%%n(Effects continued on next page.)
mahoutsukai.book.kodoku5.desc: %%nRotten Flesh - Hunger%%n%%nKodoku worms - Misfortune %%n%%nMisfortune applies various effects such as being struck by lightning, dropping items, negative looting, tripping, breaking tools, increased aggro, with chances scaling depending on the quality of the worm.%%n%%n(Effects continued on next page.)
mahoutsukai.book.kodoku6.desc: %%nEnder Pearl - Teleports target (Players must have a contract with caster to be teleported)%%n%%nNether Wart - Confusion
mahoutsukai.book.leylines.desc: Leylines connect certain points throughout the world. They can only be seen with Mystic Eyes of Fay Sight. Being near a leyline or leypoint increases mana regeneration based on a percentage of your maximum mana. %%n%%nThe Fae spawn near leylines.%%n%%nFurthermore, Leylines will boost elytra if you fly along the leyline.
mahoutsukai.book.mental_displacement.des: A mental displacement scroll allows the caster to temporarily leave his body behind and explore the world in a certain radius. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.morgan.desc: This wicked sword is the result of the corruption of the holy sword Caliburn. Obtained through the murder of a player's best and most loyal friend with the holy sword Caliburn, this sword obtains its power not from a mysterious lake, but from the killing of innocents.%%n%%nVillagers, and more so, child villagers, provide a damage bonus for this sword (requires mana), and also heal any damage the sword has.
mahoutsukai.book.morgan2.desc: Holding right click with this sword releases a ball of evil to stab and pull nearby enemies. Lastly, pressing the keybind %%k with the sword equipped provides a Rage effect, which very briefly boosts attack speed and walking speed. %%n%%nBoth of these abilities invoke a cooldown that prevents either from being used.
mahoutsukai.book.mystic_code.desc: The Mystic Code is an item which holds three stacks of scrolls. Shift right click opens the inventory. The keybind %%k switches between the scrolls. Clicking or holding right click uses the currently selected scroll.
mahoutsukai.book.nobu.desc: For those who have mastered the long range projectile come new ways of pelting enemies from afar. Acquire Nobu by using a strengthened bow to hit an enemy from 200 blocks away. %%nNobu has 4 modes of operation. Auto-Lock mode locks onto a number of targets while aiming, and fires when left click is pressed.
mahoutsukai.book.nobu2.desc: The Firing Squad modes each summon a number of constructs, which can be fired (with a short recovery) with left click. %%n%%nIn tracking mode, the constructs will follow a target as long as the caster continues aiming, and will disappear if the user stops aiming.
mahoutsukai.book.nobu3.desc: The autonomous modes, on the other hand, will not follow the target, but (up to a certain period of time) will allow the caster to use other items and Nobu's Auto-Lock mode, and will even fire in sync with the Auto-Lock mode.%%n%%nFurthermore, the autonomous modes can be controlled through the use of %%k0 and %%k1 to adjust the constructs up and down respectively.
mahoutsukai.book.nobu4.desc: %%k2 mana is consumed per bullet, and %%k3 mana is consumed once upon the summon of each construct.
mahoutsukai.book.ordered_displacement.de: An Ordered Displacement circle on the ground teleports any thing on top of it to a nearby Ordered Displacement circle. Which one it teleports you to depends on the order in which you placed the circles. You can sneak to stop teleporting. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster per teleport.
mahoutsukai.book.power_consolidation.des: This circle, when placed on the floor, will spawn a lake. Each growth of the lake costs %%val0 mana. When the lake has reached full size, the caster can throw in an enchanted sword in order to get Caliburn, a holy sword which will have the damage of the sword plus extra based on its enchantments. (hint: holier is better!) %%n %%nExchanging a sword costs %%val1 mana.
mahoutsukai.book.power_consolidation2.de: The holy sword, Caliburn, has several properties. First, undead and unholy monsters will fear it and attempt to flee. Second, right-clicking will pull both the caster and such monsters closer. Using the %%k keybind, the sword can smite such monsters, with a cooldown. As Caliburn is a sword, the Power Consolidation process can be repeated by simply enchanting it.
mahoutsukai.book.presence_concealment.de: A Scroll of Presence Concealment grants the user the two Rippers in exchange for %%val0 mana. %%n%%nWhen one Ripper is wielded, right clicking will create a thick fog around either the user, or a target the user was looking at. Doing the above with a Ripper in either hand will provide true presence concealment, in addition to the fog, rendering the player and his items invisible.
mahoutsukai.book.presence_concealment2.d: Because The Rippers are intended to be dual wielded, it is possible to attack with both simultaneously. Furthermore, attacking from behind a target with a Ripper will deal bonus damage. %%n%%nTake note that your invisibility will disappear temporarily after you attack, but it will return shortly after. Monsters may or may not be able to track you after you disappear again, so it is recommended to move quickly.
mahoutsukai.book.probability_alter.desc: Place at least 2 of these circles on the floor within range of the caster, each with a chorus fruit (see config) on top.%%n%%nThe number of nearby circles with chorus fruits when the scroll version of this spell is used becomes the Modulus of the Rule Breaker given by the scroll. This scroll costs %%val0 mana to use. See Rule Breaker's page for more details.
mahoutsukai.book.projectile_displacement: A Projectile Displacement scroll teleports you to the last arrow you shot. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.projection.desc: The first use of this scroll memorizes a tool or weapon you're looking at (for the whole stack!). The second use gives you a copy of the tool with limited durability. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster each time the scroll is used.
mahoutsukai.book.projector2.desc: The Mahoujin Projector is also wearable! Right click with an armor item on a projector to receive a special enchantment that displays that projector's settings. Right click again to get new settings after modifying.%%n%%nAlso, you can copy and paste from projector to projector by right clicking to copy, and shift right clicking to paste with a normal stick.
mahoutsukai.book.protective_displacement: Ever wondered what it's like to be an Enderman? The Protective Displacement scroll will randomly teleport you when you would otherwise have been hit by an arrow. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster when used, and provides a set number of teleports - it is not time based.
mahoutsukai.book.proximity_projection.de: Using this scroll grants the caster a weapon, which allows the caster to simultaneously teleport to and attack an entity they can see at long range. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use of the scroll.
mahoutsukai.book.reality_marble.desc: This scroll teleports the user (and optionally, a target the user is looking at) to a fixed spot in the Reality Marble. If the user has a target, one of the two must die for the other to leave. Otherwise, taking damage will allow the player to leave. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.recall_familiar.desc: When used, the player's familiar, if it exists, will be recalled to the player. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on use.
mahoutsukai.book.replica.desc: When you're done defending yourself, it's about time you start defending your friends. Replica is a mainhand greatshield with a number of abilities, granted to those who have just about maxed out their defensive capabilities, yet still feel the need to use a shield.%%n%%nNote the following controls carefully:
mahoutsukai.book.replica2.desc: AOE Teleportation: Save a location with shift+right click. Teleport to it later, along with everything around you by blocking with the shield and pressing %%k. Break a block with Replica to toggle teleporting friendlies only. %%n%%nCover Move: Sprint towards a teammate and block to place yourself between them and their closest, most threatening enemy.
mahoutsukai.book.replica3.desc: Shockwave: Simply blocking with this greatshield is enough to knockback surrounding opponents, dealing damage according to the number of nearby allies you have. %%n%%nReplicate: Replica has the ability to remember up to 6 damage types that it has blocked. You can choose Shockwave's damage type by pressing %%k.
mahoutsukai.book.replica4.desc: Note that allies refers to those for which the wielder of Replica has a geas or a contract with.%%n%%nTo get Replica, block an attack with a strengthened shield, in your main hand, while also having Immunity Exchange, maximum Damage Exchange stacks, above 15 armor, and at least %%k Death Collection souls .
mahoutsukai.book.retribution.desc: A Scroll of Retribution exchanges the health percentage of the caster with the health percentage of the target. It drains mana based on the difference between the user and target's health. The cost is %%val0 times the difference in health points.
mahoutsukai.book.reversion_eyes.desc: When used, mobs and players in the caster's view will lose their buffs, along with certain other qualities, depending on the mob. Water mobs will no longer breathe underwater - nether mobs will be affected by fire and lava. Endermen, Shulker boxes and the Wither will no longer be immune to arrows. Husks can catch fire in the sun. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.rho_aias.desc: This scroll creates a large shield in front of the caster in the direction it is used. Mobs bounce off of it, and various projectiles are deleted by it. If desired, the caster can also bounce on it by sneaking. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on use.
mahoutsukai.book.rhongomyniad2.desc: Rhongomyniad can be placed using shift right-click, where it assumes its role as a purveyor of punishment. Evil creatures and persons, including those who would do harm to those who are not evil, will be smitten within Rhongomyniad's range, according to Rhongomyniad's current attack damage. This will continually drain %%k mana. Right click on the placed lance to re-collect it.
mahoutsukai.book.rule_breaker2.desc: Furthermore, this effect is also applied when hitting things with the dagger. %%n%%nWhen a random whole number is requested, %%n(dividend %% modulus) will be returned instead. %%n%%nWhen a random decimal is requested,%%n(dividend / modulus) will be returned.
mahoutsukai.book.scrying.desc: A Scrying circle on the ground allows the player to see a named mob or player from afar, for a short amount of time. Simply drop a nametag on the circle, and if a mob or player with this name exists, it will be shown with its surroundings. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster per nametag.
Use this scroll to receive a buff. While active, tap the %%k0 keybind to swap places with a target entity. Alternatively, hold the keybind to select two entities, and switch them instead.%%n%%nThere is a short cooldown between swaps. This scroll costs %%val0 mana.
mahoutsukai.book.shared_vision.desc: When used on a mob or player, the caster will see through its eyes. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
Using this scroll summons a staff which can be used on an entity to launch them in the direction the caster is looking. Longer charge time provides more velocity. Alternatively, when used on a block, nearby entities will be pulled in and launched, after a charge up time. %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use of the scroll, %%val1 mana when used on an entity, and %%val2 mana per second when used in AOE mode.
mahoutsukai.book.strengthening.desc: A Strengthening scroll will strengthen the first thing on your hotbar, or your off-hand if you're holding something. Strengthened items are temporarily unbreakable, do more damage, and have increased mining capabilities. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use.
mahoutsukai.book.summon_familiar.desc: When used, the player summons a familiar. This familiar will report on interesting players, mobs, and blocks that it sees, and will chunk load the area around it. You can right click a familiar with a block to make it only report that block if it finds one. Right clicking without a block will reset this. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on use.
mahoutsukai.book.tangible_boundary.desc: The Tangible Boundary is a large invisible barrier with range %%val2 that you can pass through, but mobs, arrows, and other entities cannot. It will not replace solid blocks other than grass, nor will it replace water. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster every %%val1 second(s).
mahoutsukai.book.treasury_projection.des: This scroll give the user a gauntlet which will project weapons and tools from the user's treasury - their inventory, some modded bags, and their ender chest, and fling them at the target block they are looking at. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana on using the scroll, and %%val1 mana per weapon projected.
mahoutsukai.book.weapon_projectiles.desc: Using this scroll grants the caster a bow, which can shoot tools and weapons. %%n %%nIt drains %%val0 mana from the caster on use of the scroll. Shift right click with the bow to use only projected weapons (and projection scrolls).
mahoutsukai.book.william.desc: O glory to the ones who write the best!%%n For ye shall stand a head above the rest.%%n Thy Strengthened book upon a lectern place -%%n and judged it shall be on a case by case.%%n%%n For fame, how widespread is thy fiction's name?%%n Of word, both used and never before heard,%%n with frame, where punctuation is the game%%n and space, that sep'rate thoughts might not be blurred.
mahoutsukai.book.william2_explanation.de: Once a work of fiction is created, the style cannot be changed - a new one must be written to acquire higher style. Fiction creation costs (%%k * style) of the book that would be created.%%n%%nNote that positive style will result in an instance of William, whilst negative style will result in an instance of R'lyeh - and each artifact has its own illusion magic and mana regeneration effects.
mahoutsukai.book.william3.desc: With mastery of form a writer earns%%n a plethora of mana in return%%n for close circuits thy craft empowers all -%%n with mage to one receptacle it falls.%%n%%n Of course with fiction comes theater true%%n and so when placed all shall take form anew
mahoutsukai.book.william3_explanation.de: Plethora: R'lyeh will drain mana from all nearby players, including the caster. William, on the other hand, will provide mana to nearby mana circuits (or the caster if held). The amount of mana is based on the style and fame of the text.%%n%%nTheater: Placing the produced artifact in the world produces a sort of illusion magic that affects all nearby entities.
mahoutsukai.book.william_explanation.des: It seems words have power - crafting a work of writing, strengthening it, and placing it on a lectern will transform it into an artifact of sorts with properties dependent on the style of the text and the fame of the book.%%nFame is increased when the book is traded to/from villagers or read by other players, and decreased when the book is burned. Style is based on the words, spaces, punctuation, character variety, etc.

modernfix.message.reload_config: A mod config file change was detected. To prevent loading files that aren't done saving, reloading must be triggered by running /mfrc.
modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.blueprint_: Fixes Blueprint's ObjectModificationManager leaking vanilla resources, reducing memory usage. Despite the fix being contributed in PR #195 a release was not yet made.
modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.entity_loa: Fixes many issues where EntityJoinWorldEvent/EntityJoinLevelEvent cause a worldgen deadlock, by slightly deferring entity loading. Should not, however, cause any noticeable behavior changes in-game.
modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.packet_lea: **Experimental**, not enabled by default. An attempted fix for the memory leak issue that occurs after playing long enough on 1.16.
modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.paper_chun: 1.18 and newer. **A key optimization.** Ports a patch from Paper that fixes issues on 1.17 with chunkloading requiring huge amounts of memory and generating many `CompletableFuture` instances. 1.18+ are now able to load worlds on only 400MB of memory like 1.16 could.
modernfix.option.mixin.feature.spam_thre: **To be used for debugging purposes only.** Causes a thread dump to be output to the log every 60 seconds. This can help to diagnose unexplained freezes during loading/gameplay.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.async_jei: 1.16 only. **A key optimization.** Patches JEI to perform its reloading on a background thread, completely eliminating the long delay it adds to world loading.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.async_locato: 1.16 only. Backports the Async Locator mod's patches to eliminate server freezes associated with `/locate`, loot table generation, etc.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.cache_model_: All versions. Memoizes the `RenderMaterial` (texture) collection and dependency list that models return instead of requiring them to be recalculated on each request. Helps accelerate the model load/bake process.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.compact_moja: (Fabric) Experimental option that reduces the memory usage of registries by roughly 50%. Not useful in most modpacks unless they contain millions of blocks and items.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_dfu:
All versions. Modifies DFU initialization to happen the first time something needs to be upgraded. This sounds similar to LazyDFU but is distinctly implemented, as it avoids loading *any* DFU classes/data structures, while LazyDFU only disables rule optimization. Essentially, this option is a safer version of DataFixerSlayer as it will still load DFU when needed.

You should typically continue to use LazyDFU even with this option enabled, as otherwise DFU rule optimization will cause lag.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_enti: Constructs entity models the first time they are seen instead of during launch. Some mods are not compatible with this option and will cause EntityRenderer crashes.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.faster_advan: Rewrites the advancement checking logic to be faster and not cause StackOverflowError in large packs. Port of Advancements Debug from Fabric.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.kubejs: 1.16 only. Optimizations to KubeJS to avoid needless `ItemStack` copying, etc., which reduces the time taken to load datapacks.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.reduce_block:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Newer Minecraft versions (after 1.12) implemented a blockstate cache system that caches frequently used information about a blockstate, such as whether it is solid, its collision shape, etc. Rebuilding this cache is quite fast in vanilla (it takes only a second or two) but is quite slow with many mods installed, as there are many more blockstates present in the game which all must have their caches rebuilt.

This problem is exacerbated by Forge as the cache is rebuilt at many points when the data would almost certainly be unused before the next rebuild. Examples include right before reaching the main menu (during the "Freezing data" stage), as well as multiple (!) times when a world is being loaded.

ModernFix solves this performance bottleneck by instead making cache rebuilds lazy. Each blockstate rebuilds its cache the first time the data would be accessed. At any point when vanilla or Forge would attempt to rebuild caches for all blockstates, this is redirected to simply invalidate the cache on each blockstate instead.

This should not have any impact on TPS after startup concludes.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.resourcepack:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Launches on modern versions are heavily bottlenecked by filesystem access. Many requests are frequently made to resource packs to list resources or check if a given resource exists, and each of these result in a very slow file API call.

ModernFix completely eliminates most of the bottleneck here by simply caching a listing of all resources that exist within mod-provided and vanilla resourcepacks. The cache is rebuilt on resource reload (except for the vanilla resources, since they should never change while the game is running).

There are no known compatibility issues with this patch except for OptiFine (its CTM resources do not load correctly). However I do not recommend using OptiFine in any scenario, as it adds several minutes to launch time by itself and is not tested with ModernFix at all.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.rewrite_regi: All versions. **Currently semi-broken.** Aggressively replaces some internals of the Forge registry system with faster versions, however it currently causes freezes when loading some modpacks. Off by default for obvious reasons.
modernfix.option.mixin.perf.skip_first_d:
1.16 & 1.19 only. **A key optimization.**

In the middle of the 1.16 development cycle, Forge patched the game to reload datapacks twice when loading an existing world, in order to fix an issue with biome ID shifting. Unfortunately, datapack reloads often take upwards of 30 seconds and so this very severely affects world loading times.

ModernFix makes the necessary changes to avoid this reload, based on the unfinished Forge PR #8163.

This change was removed by Forge in 1.18, but then a similar patch was added *again* in 1.19 to fix mod datapacks not being loaded when creating new singleplayer worlds. Fortunately, the issue is localized to the world creation screen in 1.19, and existing worlds only require a single reload. However, this still doubles the length of the lag spike when clicking "Create New World" in 1.19, and so ModernFix again makes changes to not perform a redundant reload.
modifier.antigravity.desc: Onwards!§r\nThe arrow will maintain its height and will not be effected by gravity for the duration of the flight. Where you aim, it flies.
modifier.arrow_knockback.desc: Up and At 'Um!§r\nThe arrow will inflict strong knockback when it hits an entity.
modifier.flame.desc: Burn baby burn!§r\nSets enemies on fire for 10 seconds, and deals additional dragon flame damage.
modifier.flame2.desc: Burn baby burn!§r\nSets enemies on fire for 15 seconds with added knockbacks, and deals additional dragon flame damage.
modifier.frost.desc: Ice-ice baby!§r\nFreezes enemies in a block of ice for 10 seconds, and deals additional dragon frost damage.
modifier.frost2.desc: Ice-ice baby!§r\nFreezes enemies in a block of ice for 15 seconds with added knockback, and deals additional dragon frost damage.
modifier.hive_defender.desc: For Queen and Colony!§r\nDeals +8 extra damage against death worms and +4 damage against non-arthropods.
modifier.in_the_garage.desc: "In the garage where I belong..."§r\nDeals an additional 5 damage when player is not in direct sunlight.
modifier.splintering2.desc: A souvenir for your enemies!§r\nHits them more to deal more damage.
modifier.splitting2.desc: Three for one!§r\The sudden acceleration of releasing an arrow cause it to split into three.
modifier.surf_wax_america.desc: "You take your car to work, I'll take my board...:"§r\nDeals an additional 5 damage when players are riding a mount.
modifier.sweater_song.desc: "If you want to destroy my sweater..."§r\nTargets wearing armor have a 30% chance of their armor being removed from a critical strike.

modularrouters.guiText.popup.activator.s:
§a§nSneak§r

Toggle whether the router should simulate sneaking while doing its right-click operation.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.augments:
§a§nAugments§r

These four slots can take Module Augments, craftable items which can be inserted into a module to modify or enhance its functionality in some way.

See the item tooltips on augment items for more information on what each augment does.

Note that augments can only be inserted/removed when you are holding a single module item, to avoid augments being duplicated.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.breaker.mat:
§a§nMatch Type§r

- Match by Dropped Item(s): when breaking a block, the filter matches on the item(s) that would be dropped (note that Silk Touch will affect drops)
- Match by Block: the filter matches on the block itself, e.g. Stone in the filter would match Stone blocks, even without Silk Touch (although the drop is still Cobblestone)
modularrouters.guiText.popup.detector.si:
§a§nRedstone Signal Level§r

Here can you define the redstone signal level, an integer quantity between 0 and 15 inclusive.  A signal of this strength will be emitted in the module's direction when the filter matches the buffer item.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.direction:
§a§nDirection Control§r

This area of the GUI allows you to define the direction the module operates in. This direction is relative to the front of the router. The default direction is NONE, which for most modules means the module will not run; you will need to define a direction.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.distributor:
§a§nTransfer Direction§r

Here you can control whether the router sends items out, or pulls items in to itself.

§a§nDistribution Strategy§r

This defines the order in which inventories will be attempted. Four possible strategies exist:

§eRound Robin§r - Each targeted inventory will be attempted in turn.

§eRandom§r - A random inventory is attempted on each tick.

§eNearest First§r - The closest inventory with space to insert will be used.

§eFurthest First§r - The most distant inventory with space to insert will be used.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.extruder2.t:
§a§nTemplate§r

Here you can define a template of blocks to extrude; note that real blocks are not placed, but rather special uncraftable & unlootable template blocks.

Put ghost copies of blocks in the template to define what is extruded; blocks will be extruded from left to right and top to bottom in order. You can extrude more than one of each block if you want (left- or right-click blocks in the template to adjust).

Note you can also place non-block items (e.g. a stick) in the template; while they obviously can't be placed, they are used as spacers to "place" one or more air blocks in the pattern.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.filter:
§a§nFilter§r

Place ghost copies of items here to filter what this module works on.  If the item in the router's buffer doesn't match the filter item(s) here, then the module will not run.  See also the filter control buttons below.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.filterContr:
§a§nFilter Control§r

These buttons control how the filter is applied to the item in the router's buffer. See individual tooltips on each button for more information.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.flinger.pit:
§a§nFlinger Pitch§r

This is the vertical offset in degrees:

- When the module faces horizontally, it's the offset up or down from that horizontal (X or Z) axis 
- When the module faces up or down, it's the offset from the vertical (Y) axis.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.flinger.spe:
§a§nFlinger Speed§r

This is the speed which is imparted to the item when thrown from the router.

As a rough guide, a speed of 1.0 and a pitch of 30 (and a horizontal module facing) will fling an item about 20 blocks in that direction.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.flinger.yaw:
§a§nFlinger Yaw§r

This is the horizontal offset in degrees:

- When the module faces horizontally, it's the offset left or right from that horizontal (X or Z) axis 
- When the module faces up or down, it's the offset from the vertical (Y) axis.  This is only useful if you also have a non-zero pitch.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.fluid.direc:
§a§nTransfer Direction§r

Here you can control whether the router pushes fluid out to the world or tank, or pulls fluid from the world or tank.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.fluid.force:
§a§nXP Force Empty§r

When you empty a bucket of any fluid into a pool of that fluid in Minecraft, the fluid in the bucket is lost & gone forever. This is not necessarily desirable.

The Fluid Module, by default, will not attempt to pour out any fluid into the world, unless the target block is completely empty, i.e. air.  You can override this behaviour by toggling the "Force" button; when enabled, the Fluid Module will not hesitate to pour fluid into an existing pool - just be aware that you may lose fluids by doing this...
modularrouters.guiText.popup.fluid.maxTr:
§a§nMax Transfer§r

This is the maximum amount of fluid that the router will attempt to transfer in one operation.

Note that the transfer rate is still limited by the number of Fluid Transfer Upgrades in the router, as well as the transfer rate of the external tank (if there is one). So this number should be considered a limit rather than a target.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.noDirection:
§a§nDirection Control§r

This area of the GUI allows you to define the direction the module operates in. This direction is relative to the router's facing.

This module does not have the concept of a direction, so this area is empty.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.player.cont:
§a§nPlayer Module§r

Here you can define: 
- Whether the router transfers items from the player to the router, or from the router to the player; 
- Which section of the player inventory should be interacted with.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.xpVacuum:
§a§nXP Collection Type§r

Here you can define how XP orbs are collected. The options available depend on what other mods are installed and what experience fluids are available; however vanilla Bottles o' Enchanting are always available.

If collecting experience in fluid form, you must either insert a tank into the router's buffer capable of storing fluid by the mB (i.e. not a vanilla bucket), or place a tank adjacent to the router and check the Eject button below.
modularrouters.guiText.popup.xpVacuum.ej:
§a§nXP Fluid Ejection§r

If checked, the router will attempt to eject any XP fluid into a suitable adjacent tank (sides checked in order: D, U, N, S, W, E). Note that only XP fluids are considered for ejection, not solid XP items.

This may be useful if you don't have a mod that provides a tank which can be filled as an item in the router's buffer.

§e@player§f: match players
§e@mob§f: match aggressive creatures
§e@animal§f: match passive creatures
§e@animal(age=adult)§f: match all adult animals
§e@animal(age=baby)§f: match all baby animals
§e@living(aquatic=yes)§f: match all aquatic animals
§e@mob(undead=yes)§f: match all undead mobs
§e@living(arthropod=yes)§f: match all insectoid living entities
§e@animal(breedable=yes)§f: match all animals that are ready to breed
§e@player(holding=minecraft:stick)§f: match all players holding a stick
§e@player(holding!=minecraft:stick)§f: match all players NOT holding a stick
§e@minecart§f: match minecarts
§e@boat§f: match boats
§e@living§f: match all living entities
§e@item§f: match item entities
§e@drone§f: match drone entities
§e@orb§f: match experience orbs
§e@mob(mod=minecraft)§f: match only mobs added by Minecraft
§eCreeper§f: match Creepers
§e'MineMaarten'§f: match an entity named 'MineMaarten'
§ec*§f: match any entity starting with the letter 'c' (like Creepers, or Cows)
§e*pig*§f: match any entity with 'pig' in its name (like a Pig or Zombified Piglin)

• Prefix with "!" at start of filter to invert the test
• Use ";" (semicolon) for multiple matches in one filter (this is an OR match)

pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.amadron: §0Increases the Amadron Tablet's air storage by by 2 * √U, where U = the number of Volume Upgrades, allowing the Amadron Tablet to run longer between recharges.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.armor.c: §0With one or more Charging Upgrades installed, your chestplate can automatically charge all other pressurizable items in your inventory, either worn or carried (note: will only charge items with a lower pressure than the chestplate).

§0With one or more Dispenser Upgrades installed, you gain the ability to launch items and blocks from your offhand slot by pressing and releasing the launch key (Control + C by default).

• Some items and blocks are handled specially, deploying the item/block as an entity, similar to the way a Dispenser would operate.
• Items which don't have special handling will simply be launched as item entities.
• Blocks which don't have special handling will be launched as "tumbling block" entities, which will try to reform as blocks on impact with any other block.

Up to four Dispenser Upgrades can be installed for greater launch distances.

§0Allows Elytra gliding, just as if you were wearing a vanilla Elytra. No durability damage is taken, in return for a minor air cost while actively gliding.

Works well in conjunction with Jet Boots and the Smart Hover mode!

§0With a Magnet Upgrade installed, your chestplate can automatically pull nearby items toward you for a small air cost. The base range is 4 blocks; each upgrade installed extends the range by one block.
§0With a Range Upgrade installed in your chestplate, your reach distance (not including melee attacks) is increased by 4 blocks. This comes with a small ongoing air cost.

§0With a Security Upgrade installed, you will gain protection from fire and lava at a significant air cost: air will be rapidly dumped from the chestplate to extinguish nearby flames and solidify nearby lava.
Note: this protection activates if you are about to take fire damage, so if you are already protected (e.g. via a potion), this upgrade won't do anything.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.armor.f:
§0With a Dispenser Upgrade installed in your boots, you can kick entities in front of you at a modest air cost.  Kicked entities will take moderate damage and heavy knockback. More upgrades will increase damage & knockback, but also increase air usage.

This works on non-living entities too...

§0With a Flippers Upgrade installed in your boots, you will benefit from a slightly improved swim speed. This has no extra air cost, and is a much cheaper alternative to using the Jet Boots underwater.

§0With a Jet Boots Upgrade installed in your boots, you gain limited flying ability for a significant air cost.  When the upgrade is enabled, holding the Jump key (Space by default) will propel you in the direction you're looking.  When Jump is not held, you will slowly and safely descend to the ground (hold Sneak for faster descent).
5 tiers of upgrade are available for faster flight (and - of course - greater air usage). At tier 3 or better, you can also toggle Builder Mode via the armor GUI, which provides for more creative-style flight with faster in-air block breaking, but at a reduced movement speed. Tier 5 also allows you to hover in-place with no descent.
The Jet Boots will also function underwater, but at a much higher air cost.
§0The Stomp upgrade, when active, will damage nearby monsters if you drop on them from a great height. The damage done (and air consumed) is proportional to how fast you hit the ground.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.armor.g: §0Air Conditioning Upgrades help to regulate your body temperature for a moderate air cost. Each armor piece will help to cool or warm you as necessary to maintain a comfortable body temperature. This is most effective with Air Conditioning Upgrades installed in all pieces, but every little helps.

§0Armor Upgrades add a small amount of armor protection to the armor piece.  2 upgrades will bring the armor level up to Diamond Armor level; the maximum number of upgrades offers excellent protection.
§0A Creative Upgrade in any armor piece negates all armor damage and air usage for that piece, unconditionally.
§0A Gilded Upgrade in any armor piece is equivalent to wearing a piece of Gold Armor, as far as Piglins are concerned.
§0Item Life Upgrades make this armor piece slowly auto-repair, at a cost of air.  More upgrades mean faster repair (but progressively more inefficient air usage).

§0Protects against radiation damage from other mods, such as Mekanism. For full protection, you need one Radiation Shielding Upgrade in every piece of armor, although any upgrades are better than none at all.
§0Each Speed Upgrade installed reduces this armor piece's startup time.
§0With a Thaumcraft Upgrade installed, you get a Vis discount equivalent to the corresponding Thaumaturge's Armor piece.
§0Each Volume Upgrade installed increases this armor piece's air storage capacity by 2 * √U (e.g x2 for 1 upgrade, x4 for 4 upgrades...), allowing it to operate longer between recharges.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.armor.h: §0With the Block Tracker you'll be able to track Chests, Mob Spawners, Furnaces, Silverfish Blocks, Tripwires, Dispensers, TNT and End Portal Blocks within a range of 30 blocks. This way Dungeons, Fortresses and temples can easily be found. Inventories can even be remotely examined, as hovering over one of these indicators will show their inventories.

§0The Coordinate Tracker upgrade allows you to track one specific coordinate, which can be used for example when you are tunneling to a certain location, without knowing the exact place this location is at in relation to where you are at that moment. Meant for people that don't like to use F3. As second feature this upgrade will use Minecraft's entity pathfinding to navigate you to wherever you want.

§0When used in conjunction with the Entity Tracker upgrade, the Dispenser Upgrade allows debugging & monitoring of active drones; target a drone and use the drone-debug hotkey (default: Y), then open the helmet options GUI (default: U).

A redstone particle effect will also be displayed in any blocks that nearby (within 32 blocks) drones are interested in.

§0Activate this to make it safe to look at Endermen; they'll no longer be able to tell you're looking at them. Note: causes some visual interference, but it's better than sticking your head in a pumpkin...

§0With the Entity Tracker upgrade in, the helmet is able to track any living entity within a range of 16 blocks. These entities don't have to be visible, making this upgrade a perfect way to prevent Creepers sneaking up on you.
§0As its name suggests, the Night Vision upgrade allows you to see clearly in the dark, for a minor air cost.
§0Range Upgrades increase the range at which the Block and Entity Tracker Upgrades can operate.  Each upgrade increases the range by 5 blocks (but also increases air usage).
§0This upgrade allows you to breathe underwater, using air stored in your helmet. Note that this is less efficient in terms of air usage than an Aerial Interface, but also more... self-contained.

§0The Search Upgrade allows you to search for a specific item in (for example) your base. This upgrade depends on the Block Tracker, to be able to find the item existing in inventories, and on the Entity Tracker, which allows it to find the searched item when it lies on the ground. To experience the full effect of the upgrade you should install both these upgrades.

§0With one or more Security Upgrades installed, you gain the ability to §ohack§0 various blocks and entities in the world with the hacking hotkey (default: H).  Hacking has a variety of useful effects; try targeting things in the world with a Block and/or Entity Tracker Upgrade also installed.

§0With Speed Upgrades installed, the helmet will initialize its systems faster when equipped and lock onto blocks/entities faster (with the Block Tracker or Entity Upgrade installed, respectively).  Multiple Speed Upgrades can be installed to further reduce the initialization time, but air usage will increase.

§0With a Thaumcraft Upgrade installed, you gain the benefits of Goggles of Revealing: nodes are revealed, you get a 5%% Vis discount, and essentia levels of various containers are displayed on-screen.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.armor.l: §0With a Jumping Upgrade installed in your leggings, you will be able to jump higher.  4 tiers of this upgrade are available for progressively higher jumps (and higher air usage).  Holding Sneak while jumping will reduce the jump height to the equivalent of a single Jumping Upgrade.  Fall protection is included (no need to wear Pneumatic Boots).
§0With one or more Speed Upgrades installed in your leggings, you will be able to run faster. Extra upgrades increase the speed and air usage.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.collect: §0Increases the collection range of the the Drone by one block per upgrade.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone: §0Here you can insert upgrades into the Drone. Open up other tabs to see which enhancements can be done.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone.a:
§0Armor Upgrades give the drone a little protection, reducing incoming physical damage. A single Armor Upgrade protects drones from damage done by landing on a Plastic Construction Brick™. Each upgrade is worth one point of armor (so 15 upgrades is equivalent to a full suit of Iron armor).
Note that equipping more than 6 Armor Upgrades does carry a small movement penalty for the drone, so you need to balance protection vs. speed.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone.c: §0With one Chunkloader Upgrade inserted, the Drone keeps the chunk it's in loaded. With two, the Drone loads 5 chunks, in the shape of a cross in the cardinal directions. With three, the Drone loads 9 chunks in a 3x3 area.${br}Note that this won't allow Drones to teleport to any unloaded chunk. If you want this, see 'allow_navigate_to_unloaded_chunks' in the config.
§0A Creative Supply Upgrade negates all air usage, and all ammunition usage if a Minigun Upgrade is installed (note that an ammo box must still be carried by the Drone).
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone.i:
§0By default the Drone can carry one stack of items. For every Inventory Upgrade inserted, the Drone gains an additional slot in its internal storage.

It will also increase the internal liquid tank by 16000mB per upgrade, and 100000RF storage per upgrade (if installed). It also increases the rate at which the Drone can transfer RF (transfer = max storage / 100).
§0With Item Life Upgrades inserted, the Drone will be able to auto-repair, at a small air cost. The more upgrades you insert, the faster the repair and the higher the air cost.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone.m: §0With the Magnet Upgrade inserted, the Drone will automatically pick up nearby items, if it has free inventory space. The base range is 2 blocks, increasing by 1 block per inserted upgrade.

§0When inserted, the Drone will have a minigun attached to it, allowing it to perform ranged attacks (up to 16 blocks from the target, but see Range Upgrades) when an Entity Attack piece is used. Gun Ammo is required to fire, which needs to be imported with an Inventory Import piece.
§0Reduces the noise made by any minigun the drone may be using. Each Muffler Upgrade installed reduces the noise a little more.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone.r: §0Increases the range of the ranged attacks of the Drone (requiring a Minigun Upgrade) by one block per upgrade.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone.s:
§0With one Security Upgrade inserted, the Drone can operate within fluids; with two upgrades, fluids around the Drone will be temporarily displaced away; with three (or more) upgrades, fluids will be permanently removed.
The Drone will never willingly enter lava, regardless of Security Upgrades.

One or more Security Upgrades will also provide Drones with protection from electrical damage from uninsulated Immersive Engineering wiring; this also comes with an air cost, proportional to the damage negated.
§0For each Speed Upgrade inserted, the movement speed of the Drone is increased by 10%% of its base speed.
§0When inserted, the Drone will go into Standby mode when idle, saving air. Don't forget that Drones take fall damage, so care is advised.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.drone.v: §0For each Volume Upgrade inserted, the Drone's air storage capacity is increased by 2 * √U (e.g x2 for 1 upgrade, x4 for 4 upgrades...), allowing the Drone to run longer between recharges.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.jackham: §0A Magnet Upgrade will, when veinmining, cause all broken blocks to be dropped at the position of the block that was mined. This comes with a small extra air cost, but only when in a veinmining dig mode.
§0Reduces the noise made by the Jackhammer when it's operating. Each Muffler Upgrade installed reduces the noise a little more.
§0Increases the mining speed of the Jackhammer, with a corresponding increase in air usage. Adding more Speed Upgrades has diminishing returns.
§0Increases the Jackhammer's air storage by by 2 * √U, where U = the number of Volume Upgrades, allowing the Jackhammer to run longer between recharges.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.minigun: §0A Creative Supply Upgrade gives the Minigun infinite ammunition and prevents air usage.
§0Each Dispenser Upgrade added increases the chance of ammo effects (potions, explosive, freezing etc.) being activated. This can significantly increase air usage, depending on the ammo type in use.
§0Zooms the player view when the minigun is activated. This has no extra air cost.

§0Slowly replenishes any ammo in the minigun's magazine, but at a steep air cost. Also prevents empty ammo cartridges from disappearing.
The Minigun must be on your hotbar for ammo to be replenished.
§0Reduces the noise made by the Minigun when it's operating. Each Muffler Upgrade installed reduces the noise a little more.
§0Increases the minigun's range. Each upgrade adds 5 meters to the base range of 50 meters. Increased range comes at an increased air cost.
§0Prevents the minigun from damaging tamed entities and other players. This has no extra air cost.
§0Allows the minigun to spin up faster, reducing delay before firing, and also adds a small chance of firing multiple rounds at once. This incurs a significantly increased air cost.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.item.pneumat: §0On its own these boots are slightly better than Iron Boots. However, you can install various upgrades here to unlock many useful extra features.  The Boots provide step assist functionality for free (no upgrade, no air cost); this can be disabled in the Pneumatic Armor GUI if you don't like step assist.  The boots also negate fall damage at a small air cost.
§0On its own this chestplate is slightly better than an Iron Chestplate. However, you can install various upgrades here to unlock many useful extra features.
§0On its own this helmet is slightly better than an Iron Helmet. However, you can install various upgrades here to unlock many useful extra features.
§0On its own these leggings are slightly better than Iron Leggings. However, you can install various upgrades here to unlock many useful extra features.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.logistic_fra:
§0Active Provider frames can provide resources to Requester frames and Storage / Default Storage frames.

By default the framed inventory will provide every item in the inventory. By adding items to this filter, only items specified will be provided. Add items from your inventory or search for an item/fluid by right clicking an empty slot.

§0Default Storage frames can receive resources from Active Providers and supply resources to Requesters and Storage Frames. They have a lower priority than Storage frames, which will be always be used first if possible.

By default the framed inventory will accept any resources from providing inventories. By adding items to this filter, only items specified can be inserted via the logistics network. Add items from your inventory or search for an item/fluid by right clicking an empty slot.

§0Passive Provider frames can provide resources to Requester Frames.

By default the framed inventory will provide every item in the inventory. By adding items to this filter, only those items will be provided. Add items from your inventory, or search for an item/fluid by right clicking an empty slot.

§0Requester frames can request resources from any other framed inventory.

Here you can specify the resources and quantities that Logistics Drones / Logistics Modules should keep stocked in the framed inventory. Either insert items from your inventory, or search for an item/fluid by right clicking an empty slot.

§0Storage frames can receive resources from Active Providers and supply resources to Requesters.

By default the framed inventory accepts any item from providing inventories. By adding items to this filter, only items specified can be inserted via the logistics network. Add items from your inventory or search for an item/fluid by right clicking an empty slot.
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.security_sta:
§0This is the Security Station hacking console. You, the hacker, start at the IO Port. From there, you can hack neighbouring Network Nodes by left-clicking on them; a node hack will begin, which takes some time, dependent on the size of the target node.
Every time you capture a node, you have a chance to be detected by the Diagnostic Subroutine, which will initiate a trace back to you at the IO Port.
You lose if the Subroutine traces the IO Port. If this is a live hack (not just a test), and the Diagnostic is awake, it will hurt. A lot.
You win when you've hacked the Diagnostic Subroutine or the Network Registry; the Security Station will then cease to protect its surrounding area until rebooted by its owner.

§0The Nuke Virus is a consumable item which can be used to insta-capture a Network Node or other component without any chance of being detected by the Diagnostic Subroutine. To use it, middle-click a hackable node which already has a hacked neighbor.
Note that there is a short cooldown on repeated uses of Nuke Viruses.

§0With a STOP! Worm, you can stop an active Diagnostic Subroutine from tracing you for about 5 seconds, give or take a second or so. This software will be used in the process. To use it click on the STOP! Worm button, after you have been detected.
§eAlt + Left-Click
§f• Empty slot: mark slot (and all following slots) closed
• Empty closed or filtered slot: remove filter
• Item in slot or on cursor: filter on that item
• Also hold Shift to set item limit to max

§eAlt + Mouse Wheel
§f• Filtered slot: adjust item limit
• Also hold Shift for fast adjust

§eAlt + Cursor Up/Down
§f• Adjust item limit, like Alt + Mouse Wheel
pneumaticcraft.gui.tab.info.tubeModule: §0In this interface you can define exactly how a module should behave, dependent on the redstone signal. The signal will be proportional to the pressure or temperature interpolated between the lower and higher bounds.

relics.description.ability.levelup.auto: Holding [%1$s] during this action will automatically level up the ability until experience or upgrade points run out.

relics.description.ability.reroll.max_qu: The ability has already reached maximum quality, and this action will definitely worsen it. Hold [%1$s] before using to confirm that you understand the possible consequences!
relics.description.chef_hat.ability.sati: Killing a target has a %1$s%% chance to drop 1 meatball, identical in properties to raw beef, which can be eaten or cooked for greater nourishment.
Consuming meatballs restores %2$s health. Cooked meatballs restore twice as much.
When used, teleports the relic bearer forward up to %1$s blocks, consuming 1 unit from an internal buffer of %2$s units. The buffer regenerates automatically by 1 unit every %3$s seconds.
While holding RMB, smoothly returns the relic's bearer along the recently traveled path in time up to %1$s seconds. After the rewind ends, the ability goes on cooldown for the same amount of time the relic was used continuously without interruption.
relics.description.cut_glass_boot.abilit: When the relic is held, it functions like a regular bucket capable of storing up to %2$s liquids with a total volume of %1$s mB. To switch the currently selected liquid, hold the relic, press Shift, and scroll the mouse wheel. When the relic is equipped, it allows movement across any liquid stored in its internal buffer. Movement speed on the liquid is halved compared to normal, but for every 1000 mB of liquid of the same type, movement speed on it increases by %3$s%%.
When any of the bearer’s relics gains experience, all equipped relics additionally receive %1$s%% of that amount.
%3$s%% of experience gained by the player from experience orbs is distributed among all equipped relics.
Relics of the same type gain %2$s%% more experience from the dispersion effect.
relics.description.ghostly_mantle.abilit: While moving, leaves mist behind the relic bearer in a radius of %2$s blocks, lasting for %1$s seconds. Targets in the mist lose %3$s air per second, and the suffocation damage they receive is increased by %4$s%%.
Targets in the mist additionally receive the Tremor effect for %5$s seconds.

For each second a target looks at the relic bearer from no more than %1$s blocks away, it gains a charge, up to a maximum of %2$s charges. Each charge reduces the damage dealt by the target to the bearer by %3$s%%. When the target is no longer looking at the relic bearer, charges gradually decay at a rate of 1 per second.
Each buffered charge increases the relic bearer's damage by %4$s%%.
Once every %1$s seconds, cancels lethal damage, sending the relic bearer into spectral flight and granting immortality for %2$s seconds.
+5% experience of the current level's maximum for each death prevented
The creature that dealt lethal damage will take %3$s%% more damage from the relic bearer's next attack.
relics.description.glitchy_mantle.abilit: Attacks against the relic bearer have a %1$s%% chance to miss.

Allows the relic bearer to move through the air as if across a solid surface. If the relic bearer stands still on air for longer than %1$s seconds, the surface beneath them loses stability, causing them to start falling and take %2$s%% increased fall damage until landing. While holding the sneak key, the relic bearer can drop down manually without taking fall damage.
Allows the relic bearer to pass through solid blocks, but for no longer than %3$s seconds. If the limit is exceeded, the relic bearer returns to the last safe point.

Every %1$s seconds, leaves behind a glitchy copy of the relic bearer that exists for %2$s seconds. When a target collides with the copy, all targets within a %4$s-block radius are stunned for %3$s seconds, after which the copy disappears.

Every %1$s seconds, leaves behind a glitchy copy of the relic bearer that exists for %2$s seconds. When a target collides with the copy, all targets within a %4$s-block radius are stunned for %3$s seconds, after which the copy disappears.
When the relic bearer attacks a target, their nearest copies within %5$s%% of maximum attack range repeat the same attack, ignoring the target's invulnerability time.
relics.description.glitchy_mantle.synerg: Electric chains stretch between the relic bearer's glitchy copies, dealing %1$s damage to all targets that cross them.
Increases the damage dealt by the relic bearer’s pets by %1$s%%.
Pets within a radius of %2$s blocks reduce the damage taken by the relic bearer by %3$s%% for each pet, up to a maximum of 5 pets.

When a pet dies, a special bone drops that can be charged by killing creatures. Each killed creature charges the bone by an amount equal to its maximum health. The cost to revive a pet is %4$s%% of its maximum health.
Increases the maximum number of equipped charms by %1$s.
relics.description.jellyfish_necklace.ab: Increases the relic wearer's maximum health by %1$s% and their regeneration by %2$s%, but only while they are in liquid or in the rain.

Every %1$s seconds, accumulates a charge of electric arc, with a maximum of %2$s charges. When the relic's wearer touches any living entity, 1 electric arc is consumed, and all targets within %3$s blocks are knocked back with %4$s%% force, paralyzed for %5$s seconds, and trigger a short electric chain that bounces between nearby targets within %6$s blocks up to %7$s times, dealing %8$s damage to everything in its path.

When the ability triggers, the relic's wearer gains the ability for %10$s seconds to paralyze targets with their attacks for %5$s seconds. The paralysis only works on targets that have not already been paralyzed by this mechanic during the current ability trigger.
The electric chain's damage to targets in liquid or rain is increased by %9$s%%.
While holding the jump key, reduces the relic wearer's gravity and air resistance, and increases their movement inertia by %1$s%%. Fall damage while using this ability is also reduced, but its effectiveness is inversely proportional to the vertical movement speed of the relic wearer.
Reduces incoming damage to the relic wearer by %3$s%% while using the ability.
While using the ability, increases projectile damage dealt by the relic wearer by %2$s%%.
Increases the maximum number of equipped charms by %1$s.
While gliding for %2$s seconds, leaves a trail of electric chains behind the relic bearer, dealing %1$s damage to any target on contact.
Allows free movement within tree leaves and prevents fall damage when landing on them. The relic wearer also heals for %1$s health every second while in foliage.
When the ability triggers, the relic wearer gains %2$s additional absorption health.
The relic bearer gains the invisibility effect for the duration of the ability, but any interaction with the world will remove it for %3$s seconds.

When taking fatal damage, the relic wearer is protected from death by absorbing leaves within a radius of %1$s blocks. The amount of foliage absorbed depends on the fatal damage received, with 1 block blocking up to %2$s damage.
Leaf projectiles deal %3$s damage and paralyze all targets in their path for %4$s seconds.
relics.description.midnight_mantle.abili: Taking damage has a %1$s%% chance to release a star in a random direction, which will merge with other such stars within %2$s blocks into a constellation. Crossing a constellation line applies tremor to the target for %3$s seconds, and touching a star instantly explodes it, dealing %5$s damage to all targets within %4$s blocks. Stars also explode automatically %6$s seconds after appearing.
A star's explosion also stuns targets for %7$s seconds.

When light level is below %1$s%%, cloaks the relic wearer in shadow, granting them invisibility. Upon leaving the shadows, the ability cannot trigger again for %2$s seconds, and also not until all targets within 16 blocks lose sight of the relic wearer.
An attack from the shadows deals %3$s%% increased damage.
Increases damage dealt by the relic wearer by %1$s%% and their attack speed by %2$s%%. The effectiveness of the bonuses depends on how close the current Moon phase is to the full moon.
Increases the relic wearer's maximum health by %3$s%% and their regeneration by %4$s%%. The effectiveness of the bonuses depends on how close the current Moon phase is to the new moon.
Switching the ability's mode for %5$s seconds increases its effectiveness by %6$s%%.

When the relic wearer deals damage, there is a %1$s%% chance to summon a falling star from the sky, which upon landing creates a shockwave with a radius of %2$s blocks, dealing %3$s%% of the originally dealt damage and stunning the target for %4$s seconds.
With a %5$s%% chance, a fallen star will bounce off the surface without being destroyed. The shockwave radius decreases by 1 for each bounce. The effect can trigger multiple times.
relics.description.piglin_mask.ability.b: When trading, piglins return up to %1$s trade results for a single unit of currency.
Before trading, the piglin may immediately collect up to %2$s currency units from the relic bearer.
relics.description.piglin_mask.ability.l: Killing targets drops extra gold teeth. Their amount depends on the target's maximum health, and for every %2$s health points there is a %1$s%% chance to drop one tooth. Teeth can be used for piglin trading or melted into gold.

Picking up dropped teeth for %3$s seconds increases damage by %4$s%% and attack speed by %5$s%% per collected tooth. Picking up a new tooth refreshes the effect duration. When the number of collected teeth reaches 32, further pickups no longer refresh the duration but triple all bonuses until time expires.
relics.description.reflective_necklace.a: When the relic's wearer takes damage, there is a %1$s%% chance to create an orb storing %2$s%% of the damage received. When the relic's wearer attacks, all nearby orbs within a radius of 16 blocks are sent in turn toward the attacked target. Upon colliding with any target in its path, the orb deals the stored damage to it and then disappears. The orb will also disappear if it collides with any solid block or if no target is chosen within %3$s seconds after it appears.
+1 experience point for every 10% of the relic wearer's maximum health as damage stored in a generated orb
The orb bounces up to %6$s times off solid surfaces or when moving more than 16 blocks away from the relic's wearer.
The orb no longer disappears upon hitting the first target it encounters, and instead pierces through up to %4$s targets in its path.
When dealing damage to targets, the orb also stuns them for %5$s seconds.
relics.description.relic.rankup.warning: This action significantly affects the relic's state. Hold [%1$s] before using to confirm that you understand the possible consequences!
relics.description.researching.relic.car: To unlock this ability, you must raise the relic level to %1$s!
To unlock, you need to rank up the relic to %1$s!
