relics.description.rider_flute.ability.s: Right click a tamed riding animal to place it inside the flute. Right click again to release the animal and allow it to be recalled into the flute with another right click. To completely release the animal from the flute you must right click while sneaking. The flute can store up to %1$s riding animals at the same time and you can switch between them by scrolling the mouse wheel while sneaking.
Restores %2$s health per second to all riding animals stored inside the flute.
While the relic owner is riding a mount summoned from the flute both the owner and the animal gain %3$s%% resistance to incoming damage.
relics.description.ring_of_the_seven_dea: Increases damage dealt by %1$s%% for every 5 health points by which the target’s current health exceeds the relic bearer’s. If the target’s health is lower than the bearer’s, damage received increases by %2$s%%.
When the hunger level is above half, increases all stats of the relic bearer by %1$s%% per hunger point; when below half, decreases them by %2$s%%.
Increases luck by %1$s and loot yield by %2$s, but with a %3$s%% chance destroys loot obtained by the relic bearer.
Breeding animals may produce up to %1$s additional offspring, but the bred animals will die within %2$s seconds unless bred again.

Increases damage dealt by the relic bearer by %1$s%% for each block of vertical advantage above the target, but also increases damage received for each block of vertical disadvantage below the target.
Standing still for %1$s seconds grants the relic bearer immortality. However, while moving, damage received increases by %2$s%% per unit of speed.

Upon striking, a %1$s-second damage window opens: at its start, damage is increased by %2$s%% and returns to its base value by the midpoint, after which it decreases down to a penalty of %3$s%% by the end. Performing a new attack resets the window.
While running continuously, gradually increases the player's movement speed, reaching the maximum bonus of %1$s%% after 5 seconds. As movement speed increases, block slipperiness also increases.
As movement speed increases, resistance to incoming damage also increases, up to %3$s%%.
While drifting, scatters sparks that deal %4$s damage and set targets on fire for %5$s seconds per unit of the relic wearer's speed at the moment they appear.
Increases step height while running by %2$s blocks.
relics.description.shield_of_retaliation: Holding RMB opens a parry window for %1$s seconds. Incoming damage is blocked if its source is in front of the player; damage without a source position is blocked regardless of view direction. If the shield parries nothing during the window, the next attack against the player within %3$s seconds deals %2$s% more damage. After RMB is released, a successful parry, or the window ends, the shield goes on cooldown for %4$s seconds.

While the shield is active, projectiles flying into it freeze in front of the player and follow their gaze. Each caught projectile extends the parry window by %6$s seconds. When RMB is released or the window ends, all caught projectiles are fired from their current positions toward the target under the crosshair, dealing %5$s% more damage.
On successfully blocking damage, all targets within %7$s blocks in front of the player are stunned for %8$s seconds.
relics.description.sphere_of_self_sacrif: On use, consumes 33% of the player's maximum health, restoring twice that amount over the next 10 seconds. Up to %1$s health restoration effects can exist simultaneously. Reusing the ability resets the duration of all active health restoration effects.
Reduces incoming damage by %2$s%% for each active health restoration effect.
A crouch jump propels the relic wearer in the opposite direction of their gaze with %1$s%% force. Subsequent landings until coming to a full stop will bounce the relic wearer off horizontal surfaces, completely negating fall damage. To forcefully stop the ability's effect, simply hold the jump or crouch key before landing.

Crouching during landing creates a shockwave with a radius of %3$s blocks, dealing %4$s damage and stunning for %5$s seconds. Each shockwave parameter depends on the relic wearer's vertical speed at the moment of landing.
Increases damage dealt by %2$s%% for each bounce off surfaces during a single use of the ability.

tombstone.compendium.blessing.desc:
Each time you are hit, you have a chance to gain a beneficial effect.
Slot: Armor
Chance: 1%% per level
Duration: 2 seconds per level
tombstone.compendium.curse_of_bones.desc:
Each time you are hit, you have a chance to receive the Bone Shield effect, reducing damage and reflecting part back to the attacker.
Slot: Chest
Chance: 10%% per level
Damage: 5%% per level of damage received
Duration: 3 seconds + 2 per level
tombstone.compendium.death.desc:
When a player dies, a grave is created containing all lost items.
The player reappears with the Grave Key allowing to teleport if enchanted, as well as a Ghostly Shape effect preventing creatures from attacking you.
The amount of experience lost is defined in the config and adjusted by the Perk Memento Mori by 20 %% per level allowing to reach 100 %%.
tombstone.compendium.decrepitude.desc:
Each hit to a creature applies an effect that reduces a percentage of health over time.
Damage is halved against players with bad alignment.
Undeads can't be affected by Decrepitude.
Slot: Weapon
Damage: 1%% per level every 2 seconds
Duration: 2 seconds per level
tombstone.compendium.grave_guardian.desc:
Rarely, a Grave Guardian can appear near a Decorative Grave when a soul is going to appear (2.5% as for the Blue Soul).
This guardian will protect the surroundings from hostile creatures and will offer to trade with players.
During special events, exchanges can be different, it is a way to obtain the essence of undeath.
tombstone.compendium.grave_key.desc:
After you reappear from a death, you receive the Grave Key.
This allows you to locate your grave at a distance when you are in the same dimension.
The key can be enchanted with a Soul haunting a Decorative Grave, or by combining an Ender Pearl, allowing you to teleport directly to your grave.
The key has a chance to be directly enchanted defined in the config and adjusted by the Perk Jailer of 20 %% per level to reach 100 %%.
tombstone.compendium.incurable_wounds.de:
Each hit to a creature applies a healing-reducing effect.
Slot: Weapon
Healing Reduction: 10%% per level
Duration: 3 seconds + 2 per level
The Knowledge of Death is a list of unlockable Perks by progressing in by various ways:
- with the Ankh of Prayer
- by completing the advancements of Tombstone
- by enchanting items with Decorative Graves
- by releasing a Soul from a Receptacle of Soul.
The Knowledge of Death also increases the minimum time without sleeping for phantom to spawn near player by 10%% for each level (if the config allows it)
tombstone.compendium.ruthless_strike.des:
Increases critical damage.
Slot: Weapon
Critical damage: +15%% per level
tombstone.compendium.scroll_of_frost_res: This scroll reduces damage taken by frost by 75%.
tombstone.compendium.scroll_of_lightning: This scroll reduces damage taken by lightning by 75%.
tombstone.compendium.spectral_bite.desc:
Each time you are hit, you have a chance to trigger Spectral Bite on all enemies around.
Slot: Feet
Chance: 5%% per level
Damage: 1 per level and the Wither effect for 5 seconds
tombstone.compendium.spectral_conjurer.d:
Each time you are hit, you have a chance to conjure a Spectral Wolf or increase the remaining time of a nearby Spectral Wolf.
Slot: Head
Chance: 5%% per level
Duration: 5 seconds per level

twilightforest.book.darktower.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook that seems to have survived an explosion]]§0

This tower clearly has mechanisms that are not responding to me. Their magic almost yearns to acknowledge my touch, but it cannot. It is if the devices of the tower are being
twilightforest.book.darktower.2:
suppressed by a powerful group of beings nearby.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

The magic seems to emanate from deep within the strongholds nearby. It can't come from the goblins, as their magic is charming, but unfocused. There
twilightforest.book.darktower.3:
must still be some force still active in the strongholds.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

My analysis indicates that it comes from several sources, operating as a group. I will head back to the stronghold after I resupply...
twilightforest.book.hydralair.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, written on fireproof paper]]§0

Fire is a trivial obstacle for a master explorer such as myself. I have traversed seas of fire, and swam through oceans of lava. The burning air here is an interesting variation, but
twilightforest.book.icetower.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, caked in ice]]§0

I overcame one blizzard, only to run into this terrible ice storm atop the glacier. My explorations have shown me the splendor of an ice palace, shining with the colors of the
twilightforest.book.icetower.2:
polar aurora. It all seems protected by some sort of curse.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

I am no novice. This curse is fed by the power of a creature nearby. The cause of the curse surrounding the fire swamp was built off the power of the
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, written on waterproof paper]]§0

The mosquitoes in this swamp are vexing, but strange. The vast majority of them seem to have no natural source, nor do they seem to have a role in the local ecology. I have begun to suspect that they are
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.2:
some kind of magical curse.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

Now that I have encountered a protection spell on the ruined labyrinth here, I consider my suspicions confirmed. Both the protection spell and the mosquitoes are a
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.3:
curse. This curse seems to have a different source from the others I have encountered. I will have to research further...

§8[[Next entry]]§0

The curse seems to be of a type too powerful for one being alone to
twilightforest.book.lichtower.1:
§8[An explorer's notebook, gnawed on by monsters]§0

I have begun examining the strange aura surrounding this tower. The bricks of the tower are protected by a curse, stronger than any I've seen before. The magic from the curse is boiling off into the
twilightforest.book.lichtower.3:
§8[[Many entries later]]§0

A breakthrough! In my journeys I sighted a huge snake-like monster in a decorated courtyard. Nearby, I picked up a worn down, discarded green scale.

The magic in the scale seems to have the curse-breaking
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, written on faintly glowing paper]]§0

The tendrils of darkness surrounding this area are just a manifestation of a protective spell over the entire dark forest. The spell causes blindness, which is quite vexing. I have seen several
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.2:
interesting things in the area and would like to keep exploring.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

I have found ruins in the dark forest. They belong to a stronghold, of a type usually inhabited by knights. Rather than knights though, this stronghold is full of
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.3:
goblins. They wear knightly armor, but their behavior is most un-knightly.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

Deep in the ruins, I have found a pedestal. The pedestal seems to be of a type that knights would place trophies on to prove their strength.
twilightforest.book.trollcave.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, damaged by acid]]§0

There seems to be no way to protect myself from the toxic rainstorm surrounding this area. In my brief excursions, I have also encountered another protection spell, similar to the others I have
twilightforest.book.trollcave.2:
witnessed. The spell must be connected to the toxic storm in some way. Further research to follow...

§8[[Next entry]]§0

Such supreme weather magic must be the result of multiple undefeated great evils in this world. My studies contain
twilightforest.book.unknown.1:
§8[[This book shows signs of having been copied many times]]§0

I cannot explain the field surrounding this structure, but the magic is powerful. If this curse is like the others, then the answer to unlocking it lies elsewhere. Perhaps there is something I have left
twilightforest.book.yeticave.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, covered in frost]]§0

The blizzard surrounding these snowy lands is unceasing. This is no ordinary snowfall--this is a magical phenomenon. I will have to conduct experiments to find what is capable of
twilightforest.book.yeticave.2:
causing such an effect.
